title: Hanoi · Ha Giang Limestone Loop Stage
slogan: Two passes and 416 km, high point 0 m
story: Limestone drama and a route that is never casual. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then ride Ma Pi Leng Pass with something in reserve. The best part sits around Quan Ba Heaven Gate, Dong Van plateau, Ma Pi Leng Pass, while the fuel checkpoint and the food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 18 km this is Ha Giang Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
